page.layout: One printed page: a woodcut illustration in the middle of the page, with no running text. Mirrored show-through from the reverse side above it.
page.notes: Only a woodcut is printed on this page: a scene of rocks, a fiery burst and billowing clouds, with a figure at the upper right. Above it the mirrored text ("DE SYNTAXI", "quoniam Latinis cum Graecis...", "Exempla igitur, ubi quotidiano co-loquendi...") is show-through from the other side of the leaf, so it is not transcribed. The faint marks at the foot are also show-through. No page number, running head or signature is legibly printed on this side.
